column1: Jake McCarthy leads the slate with a strong hit probability and a favorable home matchup against Freddy Peralta, supported by a significant park boost and a platoon advantage. Fernando Tatis Jr. also profiles well atop the order with consistent contact and a solid matchup versus Eduardo Rodríguez. Freddie Freeman and Shohei Ohtani offer steady options, but McCarthy’s combination of recent reliability and environment makes him the most dependable pick today.
